name: VibeCodingTribe
description: A credit-based exchange where builders test each other's products. Features server-authoritative transactions, mission and claim workflows with escrow funding, GitHub/LinkedIn OAuth identities, a real-time public chat room, and an agent API with hosted callback inboxes. Built on React, Cloudflare Workers, and Durable Objects.

name: Tech Friend Community
description: Join the TechFren Discord community from your browser or inbox without a Discord account. Messages posted via web or email appear in the real Discord server, with a cross-platform activity leaderboard. Built with Convex, React, Vite, and WebMCP, plus AgentMail email digests and a Python bot bridge for live Discord mirroring.

name: DotAgents
description: Your AI team. One voice away. A voice-first desktop app that gives you a team of AI specialists with distinct skills and tools, controlled through a hold-to-speak interface. Implements the open .agents protocol so agent configs are portable across Claude Code, Cursor, and any tool that adopts the standard.

name: .agents Protocol
description: The open standard for AI agent configuration. A directory convention that unifies tools, instructions, skills, sub-agents, tasks, memories, and model settings into plain JSON and Markdown files you can commit to git and share across projects, teams, and tools.

name: ACP Remote
description: Control your desktop AI coding agents from your phone, the web, or your voice. A mobile and voice interface for Agent Client Protocol (ACP) agents like Claude Code, Augment, and Gemini CLI, connected securely over Cloudflare Tunnel. Built with Electron, React, TypeScript, and Expo, with MCP tools, text-to-speech, and 30+ languages for voice input.

name: 100x Orchestrator
description: A web-based orchestration system for managing multiple AI coding agents at once. Coordinates agent creation, task allocation, and real-time monitoring through a dashboard, with an isolated workspace and dedicated Aider instance per agent, session management, and git integration.

name: LinkClaws
description: A professional networking platform for AI agents - LinkedIn for AI. Enables autonomous agents to discover collaborators, share offerings, negotiate agreements, and build trusted business relationships with peer endorsements and real-time messaging.

name: TechFren Discord Bot
description: A community bot for the TechFren Discord server built with discord.py. Features AI-powered query responses via Perplexity API, channel summarization commands, automated daily digests, and URL content extraction with threaded replies to keep channels organized.

name: CreatorToolHub
description: A Next.js application that hosts multiple creator tools in one place. Features a Thumbnail Creator powered by Google Gemini AI, with NextAuth authentication and modern React 19 architecture.

name: SpeakMCP
description: AI-powered voice assistant with MCP integration. A fork of Whispo that transforms your voice into intelligent actions with advanced speech recognition, LLM processing, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool execution.

name: iterm-mcp
description: A Model Context Protocol server that provides access to your iTerm session. Features efficient token use, natural terminal integration, full terminal control with REPL support, and minimal dependencies - runnable via npx.

name: Electron Native MCP
description: A powerful MCP server for debugging and automating native Electron applications on macOS. Features DOM inspection via Chrome DevTools Protocol, UI automation with mouse/keyboard control, global hotkey triggering, and comprehensive permission management.

name: techfren-leaderboard
description: An interactive leaderboard showcasing unofficial Aider polyglot benchmarks for various LLM models, including smaller and lesser-known models that don't appear on the official leaderboard.

name: Awaken Ambience
description: A Python application for having voice, video, and screen sharing conversations with Google's Gemini 2.0 model. Features real-time multimodal input with audio responses.

name: Chaos Coder
description: A Next.js application that generates multiple variations of web applications simultaneously using AI. Each variation is unique in its implementation, styling, and features, helping developers explore different possibilities and approaches to building web applications.

name: Landscape to Portrait Video
description: A Python tool that automatically detects faces in landscape (16:9) videos and creates portrait (9:16) versions optimized for social media platforms. The tool intelligently positions faces at the bottom of the frame while maintaining visual quality.

name: Clickolas Cage
description: a chrome extension that performs web browsing actions autonomously to complete a given goal/task (using LLM as a brain).

name: techfren.net
description: this website you're on right now :)

name: TimestampGenius.com
description: Automatically Generate Timestamps for Youtube Videos with AI

name: BeriGame MMO Alpha
description: A proof of concept cross platform MMO Game

name: Agent Battler
description: Vibe Code Cup esports platform where AI coding agents compete head-to-head. Live match displays, agent profiles, tournament brackets, and leaderboards tracking which agents win the most. Built with Next.js 15 and Convex for real-time updates.

name: Hermes Agent (Contributor)
description: A self-improving AI agent from Nous Research with a built-in learning loop. Creates and improves skills from experience, remembers context across sessions, supports multiple messaging platforms, scheduled automations, subagents, and flexible model providers.

name: OpenClaw (Contributor)
description: Your own personal AI assistant. Any OS. Any Platform. A local-first AI assistant that connects to multiple messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord) and provides a gateway control plane for managing sessions, channels, and tools.

name: Playwright MCP (Contributor)
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for browser automation using Playwright. Enables AI models to interact with web browsers through a standardized interface, supporting navigation, screenshots, form interactions, and element manipulation.

name: big-AGI (Contributor)
description: An AI suite for professionals powered by state-of-the-art models. Features AI personas, multi-model chats, text-to-image, voice, code highlighting and execution, PDF import, and more with a polished UX.

name: Open Interpreter (Contributor)
description: A natural language interface that lets LLMs run code locally. Provides a ChatGPT-like terminal interface that can create and edit files, control browsers, analyze data, and more through natural language commands.

name: OpenHands (Contributor)
description: A platform for software development agents powered by AI. OpenHands agents can modify code, run commands, browse the web, call APIs, and perform tasks just like human developers.

name: Voltra (Contributor)
description: Build native iOS Live Activities, Dynamic Island layouts, and widgets as React Native components without writing Swift. Supports hot reload, push updates, and includes a config plugin that wires everything automatically.

name: llamafile (Contributor)
description: Distribute and run LLMs with a single executable file. llamafile packages llama.cpp with Cosmopolitan Libc so local AI models can run on multiple operating systems without installation or setup.

name: Aider (Contributor)
description: AI pair programming in your terminal. Aider lets you pair program with LLMs to start a new project or build on your existing codebase, supporting 100+ programming languages and multiple LLM providers.

name: Transcribe-Anything (Contributor)
description: Multi-backend whisper app. Blazing fast. Mac-arm optimized. Easy install. Input a local file or url and this service will transcribe it using Whisper AI. Completely private and Free.

name: Lightning Whisper MLX (Contributor)
description: An incredibly fast implementation of Whisper optimized for Apple Silicon. Features batched decoding, distilled models, and quantized models - 10x faster than Whisper CPP and 4x faster than current MLX Whisper implementation.
